name: vwap_mean_reversion_v12
mechanism: On NIFTY, when a high-volume flush pushes price 1.5+ z-score deviations below session VWAP (typically 10-20 spot points), it signals forced selling by VWAP-benchmarked participants who are liquidating to reduce their benchmark slippage. The volume surge (rel_vol > 1.3x the 1-minute average) is the capitulation marker — it represents the tail of the sell wave, not the start of a new trend. Once this volume spike clears the book, resting limit buy orders sitting below VWAP absorb remaining supply and price snaps back within 30-75 seconds. The reverse holds for high-volume runs above VWAP triggering short-side fade.
core_signal_oneliner: High-volume flush to VWAP z-score extreme while the flush is still live (current bar declining), signaling capitulation tail
